title.narrative: Enhancing human security and building a resilient society in the disadvantaged communities of Armenia - UNIDO component

description.narrative: This project is of strategic importance to the Government of the Republic of Armenia, as it represents an investment into the results of the Government#s ongoing decentralization reforms, under which smaller settlements are clustered into larger administrative units. This project will release support specifically aimed at these new community units, helping address the inevitable temporary increase in vulnerability following the consolidation and decentralization.
